args.title: Add option to export reports as TSV files in src/export/csv.ts
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

Currently, the export only supports CSV and XLSX formats. The request is to add support for tab-separated values (TSV) export to accommodate systems that require tab-delimited files, such as the warehouse loader mentioned.

The proposed change is to enhance the export functionality in src/export/csv.ts by allowing tab-delimited output next to CSV. This will involve updating or extending the writeCsv function or introducing a similar function for TSV that outputs tab-separated text with the appropriate content type. This change will improve usability by avoiding manual and error-prone conversions from CSV to TSV when transaction descriptions contain commas.
